versions.changelog:
Initial release providing read-only diagnostics for Alibaba Cloud CDN refresh and preload issues.

- Diagnoses ineffective CDN refresh/preload operations by querying task records and edge cache status.
- Automatically derives UID and fills incomplete input parameters; declares all auto-completions in report output.
- Integrates with aliyun CLI for all OpenAPI calls; never submits refresh/preload jobs.
- Guides users on missing permissions or incomplete diagnostic prerequisites.
- Follows a clear multi-step diagnostic flow and generates a detailed report for each scenario.
